'''Cat Dances on the Wall''' is a [[sword form]] used to knock aside a strike and go for the legs in one sweep.{{ref/book|12|13}} The movement of the form looks like a surprised cat scrambling up a wall.

==In Practice==
[[Rand al'Thor]] cut down a [[Trolloc]] with this form while escaping with the [[Horn of Valere]] from [[Padan Fain]].{{ref/book|2|19}} During the duel between Rand and [[Be'lal]] one of them used this form and the other used [[The Boar Rushed Downhill]] to counter.{{ref/book|3|55}} [[Gawyn Trakand]] countered [[Sleete]]'s use of [[The Viper Flicks Its Tongue]] with this form.{{ref/book|12|13}}
